environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, exposed directly via public Elastic IP on port 8080. Security group allows inbound TCP/8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. No reverse proxy or load balancer in front of the application. Instance runs the Flask app via gunicorn with 4 workers. SQLite database stored on local EBS volume. Environment variables: HMAC_SECRET set to production value, FLASK_DEBUG=0.
